item.title: Smoking And Quitting Behaviors Vary by Socioeconomic Position
item.description: Smoking and quitting behaviors in England 2014 to 2023 show clear socioeconomic disadvantage tied to smoking and addiction overall. The post Smoking And Quitting Behaviors Vary by Socioeconomic Position appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Endometriosis-Specific MRI Templates Improve Pelvic Reporting
item.description: Endometriosis-specific MRI templates significantly improve pelvic reporting, a 2026 observational study has found. The post Endometriosis-Specific MRI Templates Improve Pelvic Reporting appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Chikungunya Virus Outbreak Risk Grows Worldwide
item.description: Chikungunya outbreak risk is surging as Aedes vectors proliferate transcontinentally, while vaccines attain authorizations in 2025. The post Chikungunya Virus Outbreak Risk Grows Worldwide appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Obesity Linked to One in Ten Infection Deaths Worldwide
item.description: A global study shows obesity heightens the risk of severe infections and related deaths across multiple disease types and populations. The post Obesity Linked to One in Ten Infection Deaths Worldwide appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Childhood Food Allergy Risk Factors Found in Global Meta-Analysis
item.description: A major meta-analysis of 2.8 million children identifies genetic, clinical, and early-life exposures linked to childhood food allergy risk and prevention strategies. The post Childhood Food Allergy Risk Factors Found in Global Meta-Analysis appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Lead Exposure Triples Alzheimer’s Risk in US Study
item.description: National data show cumulative lead exposure may triple Alzheimer’s risk and account for 18% of dementia cases annually. The post Lead Exposure Triples Alzheimer’s Risk in US Study appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Colorectal Cancer Screening Gaps in Intellectual Disabilities
item.description: A nationwide cohort study shows people with intellectual disabilities are less likely to participate in colorectal cancer screening and complete follow-up colonoscopy. The post Colorectal Cancer Screening Gaps in Intellectual Disabilities appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Eli Lilly and USOPC launch athlete recovery programme
item.description: The initiative aims to provide elite athletes with targeted rehabilitation and holistic care for complex or extended recovery needs. The post Eli Lilly and USOPC launch athlete recovery programme appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: GLP-1RAs Linked to Reduced Haemorrhagic Stroke Risk
item.description: GLP-1RAs are associated with a reduced risk of aneurysmal rupture in high-risk patient populations, a 2026 study has found. The post GLP-1RAs Linked to Reduced Haemorrhagic Stroke Risk appeared first on European Medical Journal.
